status_summary: The Train Crew Size Safety Requirements final rule was published 2024-04-09, before the period, and no FRA action to withdraw, amend or stay it since 2025-01-20 was found in Federal Register searches. FRA defended the rule in the Eleventh Circuit, which denied the railroads' petitions for review in a 2 to 1 published opinion on 2026-08-11. FRA continues to administer the rule's special approval process, publishing a railroad's petition for one-person operations on 2026-04-14. The stage is diverged because the agency kept and defended in court the rule the text says is not based on safety.

timeline.event: FRA published notice of a Georgia Central Railway petition for special approval of one-person train crew operations on two subdivisions under 49 CFR 218.135, with comments due 2026-05-14; operations cannot start until FRA approves.
